evidence.definition: Factory-submitted substrate — spans, fields, scores, timestamps, source refs — not yet KEY memory
examples: policy clause extract + document_id + field path
gap analysis row + policy_id (observation not KEY judgment)
evidence.factory_may_include: provisional interpretation as evidence metadata — not authoritative fact_key/fact_value for Memory

fact.definition: KEY-authored normalized memory row — only after key_fact_adoption
fact.author: KEY only

memory.definition: Durable store of KEY facts — result of adoption chain, not factory dump

states_on_evidence.candidate_evidence: Factory report — in evidence inbox, not Memory
states_on_evidence.adopt: KEY accepts evidence as basis for fact derivation
states_on_evidence.hold: KEY defers — insufficient consent · conflict · review required
states_on_evidence.reject: KEY declines evidence for Memory (may retain audit trace only)

adoption_model.key_derives_fact: On adopt: KEY maps evidence → fact_key + fact_value + confidence + provenance — not factory preset fact row
adoption_model.owner: KEY via runSalesDirectorKeyTurn — sole Evidence adoption and Fact authoring authority
adoption_model.factory_role: Submit candidate_evidence[] only — never upsert customer_memory_facts
adoption_model.anti_pattern: N factories each pushing interpreted facts to KEY in parallel channels

diagram: Factories (OCR · Policy · Gap · Hospital · … — many over time)

invariants: Single KEY inbox: all factories → same evidence report shape
